messages:
Lina (CS): Hey team — prepping NovaPay QBR for next Tue. Can we get a short token spend summary + 90-day forecast? Need the ask to include: top 3 drivers of overage, current reserved vs actuals, and any quick wins we can surface. @Derek (CSM) can you sync with the account for product changes?

Derek (CSM): Yep — I spoke with NovaPay yesterday. They're ramping a new fraud-check flow next week, expect spike. I'll confirm expected traffic patterns and any promo dates.

Raj (FinOps): Pulling numbers now. Quick snapshot: current month run-rate = 1.18B tokens (~$17.7K). Reserved commitment covers 900M. So ~31% over commit. Major usage: embeddings (63%), generation/chat (32%), misc (5%).

Alexa (Finance): Oof. Do we have projected cost if fraud flow ramps by 30%? Need baseline for renewal convo.

Raj (FinOps): Short forecast (90d) assuming +30% traffic around mid-April:
```
Scenario A (no change): 90d tokens ~3.54B, cost ~$53k
Scenario B (+30% spike mid run): 90d tokens ~4.1B, cost ~$61k
Notes: embeddings drive most tokens; switching to 8-bit quantized embed model reduces embed token cost ~18% in our bench.
```

Lina (CS): Good — can you also tag which model variants we recommended earlier? I want to propose quick enablement items in the deck (batching tweaks, prefix caching).

Raj (FinOps): Model variants: embed-v2-8bit (recommended), gen-small-q (for non-critical bursts). Quick wins: increase batching window from 5ms->12ms for background jobs, enable prefix cache for recurring requests (saves ~12% tokens in our sim).

spend-alert-bot: BudgetAlert: NovaPay committed coverage breached by 22% on 2026-03-15 in us-east-1. Alert severity: medium. Suggested action: contact sales for temporary burst credit or adjust routing to dedicated pool.

Derek (CSM): I'll surface the burst option with account. Also asking product if fraud-check can be rate-limited during business hours to smooth bursts.

Alexa (Finance): For QBR slides — propose three asks: 1) approve temporary 20% top-up commitment for 90d, 2) enable quantized embed variant for embeddings, 3) agree to a joint runbook for burst control. Numbers attached to the deck need to match Raj's Scenario B.

Lina (CS): Perfect. Raj — can you produce a 1-slide spend table + 2-line recommendation by EOD? Derek — can you confirm customer willingness on the top-up by EOD tomorrow? I'll draft the slide copy and handle the narrative.

Raj (FinOps): On it. Will push the slide as a PNG to the thread when ready.

Derek (CSM): I have a 2pm sync with NovaPay tomorrow, will push for the top-up and rate-limit option.

Lina (CS): Thanks all. If Raj posts the PNG I'll pull into the QBR deck and share a draft for quick review. :thumbsup:
